Living Shadow Quirk.name: Living Shadow Quirk
Living Shadow Quirk.description:
🌑 A living shadow dwells in your body, talks with its own voice and fights beside you.

🌱 At the start it reaches about five meters, catches blows and falls meant for you or a friend, and rakes opponents with its claws.
📈 With training it pins people, hauls you up buildings, scouts under doors, digs out survivors, wraps you as armor, strikes in step with you and stays yours in total dark.
⚠️ Darkness makes it bigger, stronger and wilder; bright light shrinks it into a timid sulk.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Loss of Control, as darkness and anger loosen your hold on it.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Fumikage Tokoyami (Dark Shadow).

📈 Grants: Cooperativeness +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Output +10, Team Coordination +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Shade Catch, Umbra Rake
Living Shadow Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: a shadow creature with its own mind, voice and player-picked temper lives in the user and pours from their chest. In indoor light a new adult user's shadow is user-sized, reaches about five meters, throws an adult, claws. Darkness makes it bigger, stronger, wilder; bright light (sun, floodlights, fire) shrinks it to a timid scrap. Limits: it stays within reach, cannot fly or pass walls, feels blows and burns, can refuse orders; in total darkness it may frenzy at anyone near, allies included, until light or the user's will reins it in. Quirk Strain: light: catch, strike; moderate: pin, climb, scouting; heavy: bracing rubble or armor; severe: signature duet, control in total darkness. Type: Emitter (also fits Mutant). Law: whatever it breaks or hurts, even in a frenzy, is the user's own Quirk use. Look: hidden unless peeking; a pitch-black clawed shape, eyes glowing in the player's color; as Mutant, also e.g. light-swallowing skin or a lagging shadow.
